profile.name: ACQ400 模块化高速数据采集系统
profile.name_en: ACQ400 Modular High-Speed Data Acquisition System
profile.description: 一种机箱式模块化高速数据采集与瞬态记录设备，可集成多通道模拟/数字采集模块、触发与同步功能以及板载存储，用于实验中的高速波形采集、事件记录、校准换算和时序控制。
profile.description_en: A chassis-based modular high-speed data acquisition and transient recording system that can integrate multi-channel analog/digital I/O, trigger and synchronization features, and onboard memory for laboratory waveform capture, event recording, calibration-based scaling, and timing control.
